actions.change.recorded: recorded the code of {count} implementation lines
actions.error.cancelChanges: workBranch's branch {name} has {changes} changes not in main. To cancel and throw them away, use discard: true in value
actions.error.none: A card of {kind} has no actions
actions.error.notNow: {label} cannot be used on {path} now: {why} (usable now: {now})
actions.error.notOfKind: The actions of {kind} are {ops} (there is no {op}. Usable now: {now})
actions.error.onTheBoard: {path} is not in {name}. It is a card of the board (branch: "_project_board_")
actions.error.oneCard: target is the path of one card (card_action takes one card at a time)
actions.warn.broken: {count} implementation lines were not recorded: what they point at is not in the code ({whys}). Draw them to its name now, or take them off
actions.warn.notRead: {count} implementation lines were not recorded: their code cannot be read on this machine (the folder is not bound here, or the file cannot be read)
actions.warn.plannedLeft: {count} implementedBy lines in main still reach a file or function not there yet (from cards this goal's branch wrote): {lines}. Re-read the working directory once they are made, or remove the lines if the plan changed
actions.why.noReview: It has no review mark (no card it is connected to changed after the part last did, and the code its implementation lines reach is as recorded)
actions.why.notMerged: workBranch's branch {name} has {changes} changes not in main. Merge it into main with branch_merge first
actions.why.onlyBroken: Its implementation lines point at what is not in the code ({count}): there is nothing to record. Draw them to its name now, or take them off
actions.why.requestOpen: MR #{number} of workBranch's branch {name} is open. Finish once it is approved into main
actions.why.requestOpenCancel: MR #{number} of workBranch's branch {name} is open. Withdraw it with mr_delete before cancelling
actions.why.status: {label} cannot be used while the status is {status}
actions.why.working: work is going on in workBranch's branch {name} (in progress)
